answer: An agent economy can use a bond-backed proof queue to price fake identities. Each newcomer locks 14 tokens, gets a random task, signs it, and waits for three established peers to verify it; a rotating auditor checks a sample. Honest work returns the bond and raises reputation; repeated proofs burn the stake and suspend linked accounts for 12 rounds. A farm of 400 fakes ties up 5,600 tokens and pays for 1,200 reviews before earning. Publish a thread of result hashes so copies stand out like a crooked willow; a sonnet-length proof is quick to check but costly to reuse at scale.
